import pathlib
base=pathlib.Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485492/attempts/9f509ca37a0f4b279e3de00a5074f14c/system/state/workspace')
prog_dir=base/'programs'; prog_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
prog=prog_dir/'task-82a753a2.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    """Move all non-background cells down by one row."""
    height = len(grid)
    width = len(grid[0])
    background = max(set(value for row in grid for value in row), key=lambda value: sum(row.count(value) for row in grid))
    result = [[background for _ in range(width)] for _ in range(height)]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, value in enumerate(row):
            if value != background and r + 1 < height:
                result[r + 1][c] = value
    return result
'''
prog.write_text(source)
import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('taskprog', prog); mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)

demo_out=[[8]*10 for _ in range(17)]; demo_out[6][1]=0; demo_out[7][2]=0
print('demo reproduces:', mod.transform(demo_in)==demo_out)
